_comment: Scoring rules for flagging poor-condition parcels. Points are added per field whose value matches. A parcel is flagged when its score reaches flag_threshold. Condition scale (SLCo Residence Record field descriptions): EXCELLENT > VERY GOOD > GOOD > AVERAGE > FAIR ('maintenance, rehabilitation, and replacement needed on many items') > POOR ('major repairs needed'). Overall Condition also allows special obsolescence, shown on the page as 'SPEC OBSOL'. Condo units only rate Interior Condition (single-letter codes, expanded by the parser).
